mapper.select: select /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.member.mapper.MemberMapper.chkUserEmailDuplicate */ count(*) from qoo_member where user_email = #{userEmail}

select a.company_no ,a.company_nm ,a.company_address ,a.company_address_detail ,date_format(a.company_d, '%Y-%m-%d') as company_d ,a.ceo_nm ,a.ceo_phone ,a.ceo_email ,a.company_url ,a.company_info ,b.user_uid ,b.user_email ,b.user_nm ,b.user_phone ,b.user_office_phone from seinfo_vendor a join seinfo_vendor_manager b on a.company_no = b.company_no where b.user_email = #{userEmail}
select user_email ,user_pwd ,bl_yn ,user_pwd_init_yn from seinfo_vendor_manager where user_uid = #{userUid}
mapper.update: update seinfo_vendor_manager set user_nm = left(#{userNm}, 100) ,user_phone = left(#{userPhone}, 50) ,user_office_phone = left(#{userOfficePhone}, 50) ,mod_dt = now() ,mod_user_id = #{userEmail} where user_uid = #{userUid}

update seinfo_vendor set company_address = left(#{companyAddress}, 200) ,company_address_detail = left(#{companyAddressDetail}, 100) ,ceo_phone = left(#{ceoPhone}, 50) ,ceo_email = left(#{ceoEmail}, 100) ,company_url = left(#{companyUrl}, 200) ,company_info = left(#{companyInfo}, 400) ,mod_dt = now() ,mod_user_id = #{modUserId} where company_no = #{companyNo}
